description: This file defines the GatewayRemoteConfig enum with nested TokenValue enum and static methods for resolving and normalizing remote gateway configurations such as transport, URL, token, and gateway URL handling.

classes.name: TokenValue
classes.description: An enum representing different token states: missing, plaintext, or unsupported non-string.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport type (direct or ssh) from a nested dictionary representing the root configuration.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Determines the token value state based on the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the token string if available and valid, otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the gateway URL from the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into its normalized absolute string form.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string, ensuring it has ws/wss scheme, valid host, and default port if missing.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default port for a given URL based on its scheme.
